findings.rationale: The admin role is broadly assumable and is attached to the AdministratorAccess policy, so a compromised principal can take over full account access.
The assume_broadly policy grants sts:AssumeRole on every resource instead of limiting the action to named roles.
The external_trust role trusts a principal outside the local AWS account, allowing that external principal to assume the role.

findings.control: identity boundary: MFA condition on sensitive trust
findings.rationale: The external trust statement has no Condition block requiring MFA, so the external principal can assume the role without MFA.
